entries.current_title: Ask HN: Are books worth it?
entries.excerpt: I have read less than 50 books in my life and probably less than 5 books in the past 10 years. Growing up with the Internet, I always assumed that everything could be found for free online. I spend most of my day reading online articles/conversations, watching videos, and listening to podcasts.
